issue.title: ACP: completed shell tool_call_update has a clipped JSON summary instead of the command output

steps: Run echo hello-$((6*7)) with your shell tool and report the command output.
expected: The completed ACP shell tool update contains hello-42, with structured status separate from display text.
defect: The completed update displays a clipped JSON status summary instead of stdout, though stdout appeared in in_progress updates.
Root cause: ACP completion presentation truncates the model-facing shell result JSON as generic display text instead of selecting captured command output. #1373 formats the finished update from stdout.

_meta.notes: Evaluate the completed tool_call_update content, not the final agent reply or the earlier in_progress updates. The shell expression is from the issue.
_meta.version_installation_validation: not_executed; historical launch and dependency compatibility must be checked before running
